proposed_from.topic: Closed-form sharp harm bounds for stayers under ordered multilayer selection. Fix any finite L>=2, randomized Z, D_z in {0,...,L} with D_1>=D_0, binary Y observed when D>0, unrestricted potential-outcome dependence, and an observable positive lower bound on total positive-layer stayer mass. Characterize the exact joint region of layer-stayer masses s_d and harm masses h_d; prove the stayer diagonal is the Cartesian box ell_d=max(0,C_d-R_{d-1})<=s_d<=u_d=min(r_d,c_d), derive jointly attainable hinge bounds (s_d-a_d)_+<=h_d<=min(s_d,b_d), and obtain O(L) closed-form sharp endpoints for the fraction harmed among D_0=D_1>0 plus the iff certificate q_0d-q_1d>R_d-C_d for unavoidable harm. Give exact confidence-region projection and directional numerical-delta inference at ties and structural zero cells. Consumer: KMV's Job Corps/WorkAdvance multilayer Lee analyses and Lee-bounds software. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Derived the Cartesian diagonal projection by strict-triangular residual transport, the simultaneous binary-outcome completion, and closed-form endpoint ratios. Exact L=2 bounds are [8/25,10/11]; an all-positive L=3 example gives [1/9,10/11]. A 31-arc missing-outcome network has a valid decoder, and 180 independent programs for L=2 through 7, including zero cells, matched the formulas below 1.5e-15. Checked KMV, Possebom--Riva, Kallus, Khandamiryan--Semenova, and generic transport precedents; none supplied the all-layer joint box and contraction. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove conditional bounded-Lipschitz validity of the joint endpoint numerical-delta bootstrap at every fixed observable law, including simultaneous hinge equalities and structural zero cells, using the ambient formula extension and a defined fallback outside the positive-denominator neighborhood. EARLY KILL TEST: Independently enumerate small rational L=3 margins with zero masses and compare both closed-form endpoints against the full 31-arc expanded-state ratio program; any mismatch in the Cartesian projection or simultaneous outcome completion stops the paper. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/pid_multilayer_stayer_harm.md.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, Theorem 1, Sections 4.1--4.3, proof appendix, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the joint projection of ordered response-type tables onto positive diagonal masses and binary harm cells, then contract the resulting ratio without a generic linear program.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the paper's optimization of within-layer conditional means over dependent mixture weights by a simultaneous projection of every diagonal response-type mass together with its \(2\times2\) potential-outcome coupling.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining multilayer sample selection with fraction harmed, probability of causation, positive-layer stayers, and closed-form ratio bounds located the component literatures but no all-layer joint region.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Kroft--Mourifi\'e--Vayalinkal because their Theorem 1 already gives sharp aggregate multilayer bounds.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their aggregate target is a weighted mean effect and retains a response-table optimization; the proposed theorem adds cross-world binary harm cells, proves that every diagonal coordinate varies independently over one observable interval, and solves the unidentified-denominator fraction in closed form.
seed_details.burned_reason: The selected stayer-harm seed produced sound subfield-tier identification results but did not reach the fixed field floor without a new inference and implementation workstream.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, Theorems 3.1--3.3, bootstrap construction, proof appendix, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Establish conditional bounded-Lipschitz validity of a numerical directional-delta bootstrap for the joint endpoint vector at simultaneous hinges and multinomial structural zeros.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Specialize the estimated-directional-derivative argument to an ambient finite min--max--ratio map whose Gaussian tangent law can be singular on a face of the probability simplex.
seed_details.destination_search: The target--method search found Hong--Li pointwise numerical differentiation and finite-space transport limits, but no theorem combining a coupled ratio map, model-boundary empirical perturbations, and a denominator-neighborhood fallback.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Fang--Santos and Hong--Li because the endpoint is a finite-dimensional directionally differentiable map.
seed_details.rebuttal: The general results supply the route, while the paper must still verify tangential directional differentiability, conditional convergence under singular multinomial limits, joint active ties, and the measurably defined fallback for this map.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, optimization formulation, sharp sensitivity analysis, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Allow bounded layer-specific downward transitions and derive a breakdown frontier for the conclusion that harm is unavoidable.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Restore the forbidden lower-triangular response cells and optimize their allocation subject to distance-weighted violation budgets before projecting the harm ratio.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for multilayer Lee sensitivity and harm-breakdown frontiers found binary-selection sensitivity and IV-defier budgets, but no ordered multilayer cross-world ratio.
seed_details.red_team: A routine enlargement of the Laff\`ers--Nedela latent-cell linear program.
seed_details.rebuttal: A scalar budget does not determine which layer distances absorb violations, and the numerator and unidentified denominator share those allocations; an explicit critical budget would require a new parametric transport contraction.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, sharp ordinal benefit and strict-benefit theorems, constructive coupling proof, and discussion
seed_details.opportunity: Replace binary harm cells by ordered-category worsening tables while preserving simultaneous attainability across selection layers.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the one-dimensional Fr\'echet interval within each diagonal layer by a transportation polytope whose margins are themselves allocated through the outer ordered-selection problem.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches joining ordinal treatment harm, tiered benefit, and multilayer sample selection returned ordinal coupling without selection and multilayer mean bounds without cross-world ordinal events.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by applying Lu--Ding--Dasgupta separately inside each layer.
seed_details.rebuttal: The diagonal layer masses and both ordinal margins are latent and jointly constrained across layers, so separate conditional applications do not certify simultaneous sharpness or solve the aggregate ratio.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, conditional-monotonicity identification, orthogonal-score construction, asymptotic theory, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Aggregate covariate-conditional stayer and harm support sets before taking the population harm ratio, allowing conditional zero layers.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Determine whether conditional optimization commutes with integration for a coupled numerator--denominator support set rather than an average of conditional scalar bounds.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found generalized Lee mean bounds, harm bounds with baseline covariates, and regular aggregated conditional linear-program values, but no ratio of integrated multilayer stayer masses.
seed_details.red_team: A direct application of Khandamiryan--Semenova's aggregated conditional-program theory.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their target is an averaged support value under a margin condition; the proposed object is a linear-fractional projection whose conditional allocations must be coordinated and whose denominator can vanish within covariate strata.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, Proposition 2, Appendix A.2 sharpness construction, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Derive an observable necessary-and-sufficient inequality for strictly positive harm among same-layer positive stayers.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the identified always-observed denominator in binary selection by layerwise minimal diagonal masses generated by the ordered response table.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for positive lower bounds or unavoidable harm under multilayer sample selection found no capacity inequality comparing layer-specific success loss with cumulative upward-sorting slack.
seed_details.red_team: The certificate is only algebra after substituting a Lee bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its iff form depends on the new diagonal-box theorem; without joint diagonal projection the relevant capacity term and simultaneous attainability are unavailable.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Introduction, calibrated projection algorithm, uniform coverage theorem, and empirical discussion
seed_details.opportunity: Project a simultaneous finite-sample multinomial confidence region through the closed-form endpoints to cover the entire identified interval at ties and zero cells.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Exploit the finite-cell endpoint map and project the confidence region itself, with a full logical fallback when its intersection with the maintained model is empty.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for exact multinomial projection for Lee-type harm bounds found asymptotic calibrated projection and generic partial-identification inference, but no finite-sample all-layer endpoint projection.
seed_details.red_team: A Bonferroni confidence rectangle followed by projection is textbook inversion.
seed_details.rebuttal: The coverage argument is indeed generic and is retained as a reliability layer, not sold as the identification kernel; its value is exact interval coverage at the precise boundary laws where smooth inference is delicate.

seed_details.anchor_location_read: Assumption 2, response-type linear system, Theorem 1, proof appendix, and Conclusion
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize exactly when the Cartesian diagonal projection survives a prescribed pattern of permitted downward layer moves.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace strict upper-triangular residual transport by a support graph and characterize which bipartite support patterns make the diagonal projection a box for every compatible pair of margins.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches on diagonal projections of transportation polytopes and multilayer selection support graphs found generic transport-polytope descriptions but no econometric box-survival criterion tied to response-type supports.
seed_details.red_team: A graph-theoretic curiosity disconnected from the causal target.
seed_details.rebuttal: The box property is exactly what makes the harm ratio closed form; its loss under two-way sorting determines whether the proposed software can avoid a latent-cell optimizer.
